chapters.caption: Power wedge: a right triangle, 36 x 18 mm
Color mode 'Laser power': 150 W purple ... 280 W yellow. Every vector has 280 W
Scroll down to its child groups
Power optimization: switch from off to on
Defaults: 150 W at 0.5 mm vectors, 280 W at 10 mm and longer
Same layer: vectors shorter than 10 mm get less power
At the tip the vectors are shortest: down to 150 W (purple)
